name: Jehosheba
overview: Jehosheba is a female figure in Scripture identified as the daughter of King Jehoram of Judah and sister to King Ahaziah. Her unique attribute is her royal lineage within the house of Judah, marking her as part of the Davidic dynasty. There are no additional notes or tribal affiliations recorded for her.
namesAndTitles: Jehosheba's name means 'YHWH is an oath' or 'YHWH gives plenty, satisfies,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew meaning. She is also known as Jehoshabeath in 2 Chronicles, a variant of the same name carrying the same significance. Neither name is indicated as being directly given by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Jehosheba is the daughter of King Jehoram and sister to King Ahaziah, placing her firmly within the royal family of Judah. She is also identified as the wife of Jehoiada and the aunt of Joash, highlighting her important familial connections in the Davidic line.
scriptureSignificance: Jehosheba plays a crucial role in the preservation of the Davidic lineage during a perilous time in Judah's history. As the sister of Ahaziah and wife of Jehoiada, she protected Joash, her nephew, ensuring the continuation of God's covenant promises through the royal line. Her actions demonstrate faithfulness to God's plan amidst political turmoil, underscoring her significance in the biblical narrative.
